Mandatory backend security suite passed (9/9), full backend regression passed (55/55), additional independent security runtime checks passed (7/7 added). CSRF enforcement for cookie-auth unsafe methods is effective, including referer-origin validation; /api/google/connect correctly migrated to POST (GET returns 405).

Runtime edge behavior note: evil preflight returned app-level 403 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to primary FRONTEND_URL; preview-ingress 204 wildcard-without-credentials variant was not observed in this run.
